argv: git log --format=%H 01d586ddbc5fcd78659557c4e93a6ee8517b87d1 -- tools/mutate-and-run.sh | while read r; do s=$(git show $r:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | sha256sum | cut -c1-16); n=$(git show $r:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | wc -l); b=$(git show $r:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | wc -c); v=$(git show $r:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | grep -m1 -o "mutate-and-run.sh r[0-9]*-[0-9]*"); echo "$(git log -1 --format="%h %ad" --date=short $r) $s L=$n B=$b $v"; done
